high_level_description: This image depicts the exterior of a quaint shop named "Shop at The Green Dragon." The building is constructed with light-colored stone and has a traditional design, featuring a sloped roof with dark slate tiles. The roofline includes a decorative element resembling a zigzag pattern near the peak. The shop's signage is prominently displayed on the front wall. It lists various products and services offered: Grocery, Dairy, Fruit & Veg., Wines Spirits, Minerals, Fresh Coffee, and Homewares.
